concerns.text: T020A and T020B are marked [P] (parallel-safe) but the task descriptions explicitly state 'MUST run after T020A' and 'MUST run after T020B' respectively. Furthermore, the 'Sequential Enforcement' note in Phase 4 contradicts the [P] tags. These tasks share the same output file (artifacts/model_metrics.json) and depend on the same input dataset; running them in parallel would cause race conditions on file writes and inconsistent metric aggregation.

T012b (Checksum Verification) is marked [P] but explicitly depends on T012 (Soil Data extraction) which generates the checksum file. T012b cannot execute before T012 completes. The [P] tag is incorrect here as it implies independence from T012.
T017 (Generate excluded species summary) is marked [P] but depends on T015 (Validation) which generates the species counts. T017 cannot run before T015. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T025b (Generate bar chart) is marked [P] but depends on T025a (Generate CSV). The [P] tag is incorrect as the chart generation cannot proceed without the CSV artifact.
T027 (Sensitivity p-values) is marked [P] but depends on T025a (Feature importance CSV). The [P] tag is incorrect.
T028 (Aggregate stability) depends on T027. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T029 (Generate report) depends on T028 and T035. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T300 (Robust Checksum Verification) depends on T012b. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T301 (Permutation Test Rationale) depends on T022. The [P] tag is incorrect.
T302 (API Error Handling) depends on T012. The [P] tag is incorrect.
